name: KRUISJASSEN
description: Kruisjassen is a Dutch jass game played by four players in fixed partnerships, two against two. This format gives the game its name, which means 'cross-jass'. As played in the east of the Netherlands, it is one of the most straightforward forms of jass, simpler than the better known Klaverjassen. There is no bidding, trumps are chosen simply by turning a card at the end of the deal, and the result is determined by the value of cards taken in tricks.

content.text: Kruisjassen is a Dutch jass game played by four players in fixed partnerships, two against two. This format gives the game its name, which means 'cross-jass'. As played in the east of the Netherlands, it is one of the most straightforward forms of jass, simpler than the better known Klaverjassen. There is no bidding, trumps are chosen simply by turning a card at the end of the deal, and the result is determined by the value of cards taken in tricks.

Kruisjassen developed in the eastern Netherlands as a simplified variant of the broader Jass family of games. The name refers to the cross-wise seating of partnerships. It emerged as a more accessible alternative to complex bidding games like Klaverjassen.
Four players in fixed partnerships, two against two. Partners sit opposite each other.
32-card French-suited pack (7 through Ace in each suit).
32-card French-suited pack (7 through Ace in each suit).

Dealer shuffles, offers to player on left to cut, then deals: 3 cards each, then 2 cards each, then 3 cards each. The last card (dealer's last card) is placed face up to determine trump suit, then taken into dealer's hand. Each player has 8 cards.

items.text: Fixed Length Game: Play a fixed number of deals (e.g., 8 or 16) and add up card points. Team with higher grand total wins.

Kruisjassen with Tik: If a team reaches 50 card points during play, they may tap the table ('tik') to score 1 game point immediately. If both reach 50, first to tap wins. A team that taps and wins all tricks scores 6 game points.

Kruisjassen with Roem: Adds meld points for card combinations held in hand: sequences (20-100 points) and four-of-a-kinds (100-200 points). Team with best roem scores for all their combinations. Also includes 'stuk' (K+Q of trumps) for 20 points.
All Tricks Bonus Tournament: In tournament play, winning all 8 tricks scores an extra bonus of 100 card points (total 246).
